title: CERT is releasing six CVEs for serious security vulnerabilities in dnsmasq
summary: US-CERT is releasing six critical CVEs for serious security vulnerabilities in dnsmasq, a widely-used DNS caching and DHCP server software commonly found in embedded systems and routers. This is significant as dnsmasq is deployed in millions of devices worldwide.
problem_solved: Discloses multiple serious security vulnerabilities affecting a widely deployed network service software.
why_valuable: Critical security patches needed for dnsmasq installations across routers, IoT devices, and Linux systems to prevent potential remote attacks.
